 Preorder GTA 6 at Costco for $80—Limited-Time Offer With Exclusive Bonuses
 Parade Follow Nathan Hutsenpiller Mon, November 16, 2026 at 3:36 AM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Mon, November 16, 2026 at 3:36 AM UTC It's officially release week, and if you haven't pulled the trigger on preordering Grand Theft Auto VI , there's still time to make up your mind. But with only four days left to score extra goodies available exclusively to early buyers, the clock is ticking to get the most bang for your buck.
 Fortunately, Costco just joined the ranks of retailers selling physical cases with digital downloads of GTA 6 inside, making these next few days your opportunity to head to your local warehouse and snatch one up while you still can. After all, if you've been patiently waiting for the most anticipated game in history, you'll want to be ready to play on day one, just like everybody else.
 😋😋   SIGN UP to get delicious recipes, handy kitchen hacks & more in our daily Pop Kitchen newsletter 🍳 🍔 
 Grand Theft Auto VI (Code in Box) – PlayStation 5, $79.99 at Costco 
 Spotted this weekend by @costcochika , who quickly shared the news on social media: Grand Theft Auto VI (Code in Box) – PlayStation 5 edition retails for just $79.99, with a limit of five copies per member. The game follows main protagonists Jason and Lucia, who have always had the deck stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of Vice City , smack in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Along with your preorder, you'll be able to preload the game early, so it's ready to play as soon as it officially launches on Thursday, Nov. 19. As an added bonus, this edition also includes the Vintage Vice City Pack, featuring a '55 Vapid Stranier Sedan and garage, bonus outfits and hairstyles and an exclusive weapon pattern for both Jason and Lucia.
 Related: Aldi's $5 Bedazzled Martini Keychain Is a Chic Little Holiday Accessory 
 How Does Costco's GTA 6 Preorder Compare to the PlayStation Store?
 If you'd rather have something to unwrap or keep on display at home, Costco's $80 GTA 6 preorder is the way to go. The code-in-box edition includes the same game and Vintage Vice City Pack as the PlayStation Store version, making the physical case the real draw. That said, PlayStation Store preorders include a free month of GTA+, but if you're already a subscriber, it might be worth snagging the physical case at Costco for the same price.
 Nov. 19 is coming up fast, and if you want in on the excitement come release day, this is one preorder you won't want to miss. A game this highly anticipated doesn't come around often, and you'll be glad you pulled the trigger when GTA 6's iconic logo lights up your TV screen later this week.
